title: Hornig guards the Trinity bomb the night before the test
summary: Kevin Knuth tells of Hornig guards the Trinity bomb the night before the test, about 1945 at White Sands and Holloman, New Mexico, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And on the night before the first test at Trinity, Oenheimer gave him a weapon and made him guard the bomb in the tower during a storm.

plain: A researcher named Kevin Knuth passes on a story from a scientist named Donald Hornig about Trinity, the first atomic bomb test, held in New Mexico in 1945. According to Hornig, the night before the test, Robert Oppenheimer, who led the bomb project, handed him a gun and had him guard the bomb up in its tower during a storm. Knuth tells it to show how close Hornig was to the heart of America's most secret work.
